The game that onboards the world into Fluid. A street-football RPG — Lagos culture, real ownership.

How it works

1
Play.

Fast street-football matches — phone-first, Lagos pitch energy, players everywhere.

2
Grow your Companion.

Your soulbound Companion NFT levels up with your match stats. It can never be sold or taken — it is you in the game.

3
Earn RAIN.

Match rewards and tournament drops accrue as RAIN. Claim with one tap — it lands in this Fluid wallet, on-chain, yours.

4
Spend it anywhere.

RAIN sits beside your BTC, ETH and stablecoins — send it, or cash out to a bank in 180+ countries.

Status: wallet-first

The claim plumbing is being built BEFORE the game launches: RAIN drops use signed Merkle proofs (you claim directly; Fluid never custodies rewards), and the Companion contract already lives in the open-source repo, ready for Sui testnet.

Settings & safety

The backup file is only as strong as your password — anyone who gets the file can guess at it offline, for as long as it takes. Guard it like the seed phrase.

Connect Fluid to other apps (dApps) that offer WalletConnect. You review and approve every connection and every signature here in Fluid — nothing is ever signed sight unseen.

Your Fluid name

One name for every chain — people send to you.fluid.is-a.dev instead of a long address. Names live in the public registry in the open-source repo; first come, first served.

Agentic wallet

Give an AI agent its own wallet on Fluid. Agents get full blockchain access — every chain — with no KYC and no on/off-ramps, ever. The agent wallet is a separate account from yours (same seed backup), with spending caps you set. The agent can only request transfers; you approve and Fluid signs.
